ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)
base_address: Defined at SoC level; offsets given relative to module base.
notes: JESD204 link parameters are programmed through the converter's device control interface (commonly SPI) and are also transmitted in-band as the ILAS link-configuration octets. The standard fixes the ILAS octet format; the exact SPI register addresses are vendor-defined.

register_access.transport: Vendor device control bus (typically SPI) plus in-band ILAS link-configuration octets
register_access.purpose: Configure and verify the L/M/F/S/N/N'/K link parameters, subclass, scrambling, version, and device IDs.
register_access.in_band_mirror: ILAS multiframe 2 carries the link config for RX verification.
